_note: The Field Journal (docs/26-come-back.md). Each entry reads one stat (shared/src/stats.ts) and fills in over its tiers: one tier for a discovery, three for a deed (sketch, full entry, coloured plate). Counts are across all your colonies, since space caps one colony, and no entry needs a particular ground. The entry's title is yours to wear from its first tier. hidden: shown as an unwritten page until earned (oddities; never needed for anything). Titles are cosmetic only (pillar 3).

entries.name: Pavement Ants
entries.title: Border Warrior
entries.text: Every spring, neighbouring colonies meet on the pavement and wrestle in their thousands over a border line.

entries.name: Fire Ants
entries.title: Fireproof
entries.text: Their sting burns. When floods come, they link legs and float away as a living raft.

entries.name: Carpenter Ants
entries.title: Woodcutter
entries.text: They carve smooth galleries through damp wood, but never eat it.

entries.name: Honeypot Ants
entries.title: Pantry Raider
entries.text: Some workers hang from the ceiling, swollen round with nectar: living jars for the lean months.

entries.name: Trap-jaw Ants
entries.title: Jaw-dodger
entries.text: Their jaws lock open and snap shut faster than almost anything alive. A snap against the ground throws them clear.

entries.name: Termites
entries.title: Mound-breaker
entries.text: Not ants at all, but cousins of the cockroach, raised in cathedrals of chewed mud.

entries.name: Trapdoor Spider
entries.title: Spider-slayer
entries.text: She waits under a silk-hinged door and feels for footsteps on the threads outside.

entries.name: Dead grasshopper
entries.title: Scavenger
entries.text: A meadow's worth of protein, if you can hold it long enough to carry it home.

entries.name: Fallen fig
entries.title: Fig-finder
entries.text: Split open and sweet. Every forager in range smells it at once.

entries.name: Leafy branch
entries.title: Leaf-hauler
entries.text: Torn down by the wind: more leaves than a garden grows in a day.

entries.name: Dead beetle
entries.title: Shell-cracker
entries.text: Armoured even in death. The meat is worth the long work on the shell.

entries.name: Sugar spill
entries.title: Sweet-tooth
entries.text: Pure sweetness, drying in the sun. Whoever gets there first drinks deep.

entries.name: The roster
entries.title: Brood-keeper
entries.text: Kinds of ant and ally you have raised. One queen's eggs become workers, soldiers and scouts by how the larvae are fed.

entries.name: Leaf Gardens
entries.title: Gardener
entries.text: Levels of Leaf Garden across your colonies. Leafcutters don't eat the leaves: they farm a fungus on them.

entries.name: Hunting Grounds
entries.title: Huntress
entries.text: Levels of Hunting Grounds across your colonies. Every hunter is a sister, and every sister is armed.

entries.name: Aphid Pastures
entries.title: Shepherd
entries.text: Levels of Aphid Pasture across your colonies. Ants stroke aphids for honeydew and drive off the ladybirds.

entries.name: Digs finished
entries.title: Excavator
entries.text: Each pellet of soil is carried up and dropped on the mound. The nest grows down as the mound grows up.

entries.name: Ants raised
entries.title: Brood-tender
entries.text: Nurses lick the eggs clean, feed the larvae and carry the cocoons to warm galleries.

entries.name: Research
entries.title: Naturalist
entries.text: Levels of research learned. A colony remembers in scent, not in words.

entries.name: Forage parties home
entries.title: Forager
entries.text: Parties that came back from the wilds. Most foragers are the colony's oldest ants: the risky work falls to those with least life left.

entries.name: Food carried home
entries.title: Provider
entries.text: Everything your parties carried home on their backs.

entries.name: Corpses hauled
entries.title: Undertaker
entries.text: Protein hauled from battlefields. Nothing is wasted in an ant colony, least of all the dead.

entries.name: Places scouted
entries.title: Pathfinder
entries.text: Scouts walk alone and mark the way home with a thin trail of scent.

entries.name: Fights won in the wilds
entries.title: Raider of the Wilds
entries.text: Wild nests, mounds, dens and windfalls taken by force.

entries.name: Swarms beaten
entries.title: Swarm-breaker
entries.text: Army ants eat everything in their path. Almost everything.

entries.name: Raids held off
entries.title: Gatekeeper
entries.text: Some ants plug the nest entrance with their own flat heads.

entries.name: Windfalls claimed
entries.title: Claim-jumper
entries.text: First to the food, and still holding it when the others arrive.

entries.name: Honeydew from herds
entries.title: Herder
entries.text: Nectar your tenders sent home from aphid herds in the wilds.

entries.name: Colonies
entries.title: Founder
entries.text: Colonies you rule. Each began as one winged queen who dug in alone.

entries.name: Colony needs met
entries.title: Dutiful
entries.text: Days the colony asked, and you listened.

entries.name: Gifts from the nest
entries.title: Fortunate
entries.text: Small luck in the nest: a lost beetle, an aphid boom, a gust of leaves.

entries.name: A truce
entries.title: Peacemaker
entries.text: Two colonies that agreed to leave each other be.

entries.name: A supercolony
entries.title: Supercolonist
entries.text: Nests that share one scent and treat each other as sisters. The largest known runs for thousands of kilometres.

entries.name: The Boot
entries.title: Boot-dodger
entries.text: Something enormous came down from the sky.

entries.name: Spider's lunch
entries.title: Spider-bait
entries.text: Not every silk thread is a bridge.

entries.name: Caught in the rain
entries.title: Rain-soaked
entries.text: To an ant, a raindrop is a falling boulder of water.

entries.name: A shortcut
entries.title: Trailblazer
entries.text: Ants keep straightening their trails, and the shortest path wins.

entries.name: Lost the trail
entries.title: Wanderer
entries.text: Wind can blow a scent trail away in minutes.

entries.name: Dead lizard
entries.title: Lizard-hauler
entries.text: Rare, huge, and worth a war.

entries.name: Picnic crumbs
entries.title: Picnic-raider
entries.text: The giants eat in the open and leave half of it behind.
